_comment: Pattern-based genre extraction for treebank-specific metadata formats
_format: Treebank code -> list of pattern objects

_pattern_fields.pattern: Required: regex to match against sentence comments
_pattern_fields.genre: Optional: static genre or $1/$2 for capture groups
_pattern_fields.genre_mapping: Optional: dict mapping captured values to genres

en_ewt._description: Extract genre from document ID prefix

en_gum._description: GUM corpus uses genre in document ID

fi_tdt._description: Finnish TDT encodes genre in doc_name

cs_pdt._description: Czech PDT uses source field with mapping

cs_cac._description: Czech CAC: extract first and last letter from doc ID (e.g., a01w -> aw)
cs_cac._example: # newdoc id = a01w -> extracts 'aw' -> maps to 'news'

fr_gsd._description: Extract from file path in sent_id

ja_gsd._description: Japanese GSD with source type mapping

_comment_patternless: Pattern-less mappings apply to standard automatic extraction

de_lit._note: No pattern needed - applies to standard # genre = ... extraction
